Ikea light bulbs (tradfri) and switches ([reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/homeassistant/comments/fw5d0i/ikea_tradfri_and_zigbee2mqtt/))

`For the bulbs you turn them off and on 6 times and then it starts  blinking and just stop there, then it should be automatically discovered  (at least it did for me with zigbee2mqtt).`

`For the remotes press pair button 4 times quick.`

`See also https://www.zigbee2mqtt.io/information/supported_devices.html#ikea`
